summary: Verbose capture is valuable when it surfaces constraints and motivation that a short ticket would omit; verbosity by itself can also bury priorities and contradictions.

points.text: Preserve the recording or raw transcript as evidence, but require the system to produce a compact intent contract containing goal, non-goals, constraints, acceptance evidence and unresolved questions.
Do not silently repair domain terms, numbers or negation. Highlight uncertain transcription spans and ask for confirmation when they affect implementation.
Compare clarification rounds, changed requirements, task success and review corrections against typed intake; words per request is not a success metric.
